settings.eyebrow: Our approach / From idea to entrance
settings.title: A considered way in.
settings.text: Every memorable entrance begins with a point of view. Here is how a composition takes shape, and what happens after you approve yours.

settings.title: Approve your design.
settings.text: Review your palette, scale, services, and notes before approving. If you change a choice afterward, you will need to approve the updated design again. Approval is not an order or a reservation; the final review and checkout become available only when the offers are ready.

settings.title: Plan the timing.
settings.text: Your selected week is a preference, not a booked date. Add an event date in your notes if timing matters. Availability and scheduling will need confirmation before an installation or delivery.

settings.title: Choose how it arrives.
settings.text: Custom installation means the display is styled at your entry. Delivery only leaves the arrangement to you. You can also upload a PNG or PDF for vinyl-wrapped artwork on a white or orange pumpkin, choosing white, black, or gold vinyl, or request post-season removal. Once details and pricing are confirmed, you can review your selection before secure checkout.
